description: This file is a PHP script that implements a web page for searching and displaying test case search results within a testing management system (TestLink). It includes logic for initializing the page, processing search parameters, querying the database, and rendering results in a table format. The script also manages user interface elements, handles input sanitation, and constructs complex SQL queries to filter test cases based on various criteria.

classes.name: tlExtTable
classes.description: A class used for rendering HTML tables with extended functionalities, such as sorting and grouping, to display test case search results.

methods.name: buildExtTable
methods.description: Constructs an HTML table for displaying search results of test cases, including links for editing and viewing history.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes search parameters from user input, preparing filters and query arguments.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI state for the search page, including page title and default messages.

methods.name: initSearch
methods.description: Populates GUI elements with current search parameters and options based on the user's input and project settings.
